The One With The Baby On The Bus: Chandler and Joey lose Ross's son while checking out women on the bus. Meanwhile, Phoebe loses her Central Perk singing gig to a professional singer. (S2, E.
The One Where Ross Finds Out: A drunken Rachel is persuaded to call Ross and reveal her feelings for him on his answering machine. Now, Ross must make a decision between her and Julie. (S2, E.
Joey and Chandler try to help Ross with his decision to date either Julie or Rachel by making a list of the pros and cons about each. (S2, E.
Phoebe tries to track down her real father. Meanwhile, Monica and Rachel's apartment radiator breaks during a holiday party. (S2, E.
While dating a guy named Russ, Rachel can't see his uncanny resemblance to Ross. Meanwhile, Monica gets back together with "fun Bobby". (S2, E.
The One With The Lesbian Wedding: Monica caters the wedding of Ross's ex-wife and her lesbian lover. Meanwhile, Rachel's mum comes to visit with news that she is divorcing her father. (S2, E.

The One With The Prom Video: Monica and Rachel's prom video reveals Monica's former girth, Rachel's former nose and the way Ross has always felt about Rachel. (S2, E.

The One Where Joey Moves Out: After having a fight with Chandler, Joey moves out. Monica's father finds out that his best friend (Tom Selleck) and Monica are dating. (S2, E.
The One Where Eddie Moves In: Joey considers moving back in with Chandler, but Chandler has a new roommate. A record producer wants to make a music video for Phoebe's song, "Smelly Cat". (S2, E.
Ramoray Dies: Joey's soap opera character gets dropped down an elevator shaft after Joey brags of writing his own lines in an interview. (S2, E.
The One Where Eddie Won't Go: Chandler demands that his bizarre new roommate, Eddie, moves out, but he doesn't seem to get the message. (S2, E.
A pair of mismatched LAPD detectives (Mel Gibson and Danny Glover) investigate a suicide that leads to an international crime ring and ever-increasing danger.

programmes.t: Jimmy Carr's Am I The Asshole?
programmes.d: Jimmy Carr, GK Barry and Jamali Maddix are seeking out a****** behaviour. There's a woman who lied about a dog's ashes and someone who believes they're the reincarnation of Princess Diana. (S2, E.
The boys try to grow their own tobacco like George Washington. // Beavis and Butt-Head go to the courthouse to settle a parking ticket and end up getting married. (S2, E.
Sad Boys / Are You There God? It's Me, Beavis: The pair pretend to be sad and end up in a psychiatric hospital. // Beavis' body goes through changes after he is bitten by a rabid skunk.(S2,E.
Randy is rallying the mall staff! Outside the mall, zombie-like masses are restless, and King Cartman prepares for battle with Princess Kenny - Black Friday is on! (S17, E.
While Wendy tries to expose the widespread Photoshop fakery of the female form, Kanye West tries to prove to the world his fiancée isn't a hobbit - will either succeed?!? (S17, E.
The boys decide to create a company funded through Kickstarter so that they never have to work. When they take the Washington Redskins' name, the football team see red! (S18, E.

Join The Daily Show team as they take a satirical sideswipe at the latest in news and current affairs. Emmy Award winning irreverence from Comedy Central.

A soda company gives Phoebe $7,000 after she finds a dismembered thumb in a can of soda. Meanwhile, Chandler is smoking again, to his friends' dismay. (S1, E.

Debra starts to choke on a piece of orange, but Ray does nothing. When she accuses him of being useless during emergencies, he talks to his mother. Marie agrees. (S5, E.

At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical.
While Peppa and her friends are at Playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a Lucky Hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle.
It is back to Granny Pig's historical re-enactment society for a space adventure, as Peppa and George re-enact the Apollo moon landing.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle and her wonky house.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party! The children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They have great fun learning to play.
Peppa, Suzy Sheep, Mummy and Daddy help George understand what a potty is and how to avoid accidents. George gains confidence.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language. Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Nanny Plum and the Wise Old Elf compete to build a boat that will beat the Marigolds'.
Holly takes some frogspawn home from class to look after, but is surprised when the frogspawn turns into tadpoles overnight. Soon there are lots of little frogs for Holly to look after.
Kana and Thomas deliver aquarium materials for the Vicarstown Fish Day, while Percy and Nia deliver the fish themselves.
As Percy complains that Thomas isn't listening to him, Thomas doesn't notice when Percy Disappears, falling off the track and getting lost.
Stan finds a special star stone which Grandad believes will bring him luck - and it does! But when Stan loses his star stone, will his luck change.
Grandad's gnomes go missing. The mystery deepens when Stan finds a tiny human handprint! The gnomes can't really have come to life, can they?
Tim and Tommy go on a camping trip but soon disagree on what to do first.
The kids become the parents and the parents become the kids.
Tim tries to return a lost walky talky to its owner.
Paddington must keep his promise to not make a mess in 'Paddington's Goo Monster', then in 'Paddington's Apple Pip Adventure', Paddington and Simi go on a journey into the human body.
Grandpa is building something in his shed. It is his latest pet project. It's a robot called Frank.
Peppa and her friends are at playgroup. Madame Gazelle is teaching the children fun games to play with paper.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George are going to the seaside. Mummy and Daddy explain clouds to Peppa and George who have a little sing and dance about clouds.

Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio.
Peppa is at Suzy's house and there is a pile of cardboard boxes so, they take them outside to play with. Peppa turns the boxes into a cardboard shop, a spaceship and even a hospital.
Suzy describes a takeaway and the children want to make their own. Together they 'cook' and deliver the pretend takeaways to the parents. They get great reviews too.
Grandpa Pig has created a watering system, but he does not remember which button is which so Peppa and George help using walkie talkies. The Police hear their signal and are surprised.
Mummy and Daddy Pig are working in their home office and Peppa wants to 'work' like them too. Peppa decides that she needs her own office, so she takes the cupboard under the stairs.
Peppa and her family take a poorly swift to the vet's. After a night of rest, the swift recovers and Doctor Hamster releases it so it can fly around the world again.

Peppa hands Penny and Pedro the wrong glasses by mistake and they can't see very well. Madame Gazelle then tells them the importance of lenses and how they're in all sorts of things.
Holly breaks her wand and must go to the Wand Factory, at the bottom of the Great Elf Tree, to get it fixed.
Snooty King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit, but when the King's new clothes get dirty Nanny cleans them, along with the King's old clothes - and shrinks them all.
Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen and even meet a dragon. It's George's favourite day ever.

A rare 1980s Sierra Cosworth draws in a crowd of Ford fans, while a restorer delights buyers with his 1966 Sunbeam Rapier and Sarah takes a shine to a caravan.
Derek waxes lyrical about a pristine Jaguar XJ8 and a Ford Model T van tests his driving skills.

programmes.d: On the Wirral, Simon O'Brien has a crazy plan to turn a chunky chain into a standard lamp, while Henry Cole restores a 1963 Ford Anglia.
Travelling from Barcelona to Majorca, Michael Portillo traces the early roots of the Spanish Civil War, which divided his family and sent his father into exile.

Michael Portillo travels from the chateaux of the Loire Valley to the heart of the Champagne region at Reims.
Michael Portillo goes on a rail journey through Germany, beginning in the vibrant city of Berlin, where he visits the Museum of Modern Art in Kreuzberg.
Derek travels to the Yorkshire coast to pick up a 1963 Austin J2 Paralanian campervan described as the Rolls Royce of campervans.
Derek picks out a super low mileage MGC and the team pays a little too much to secure it.
Legendary actor Laurence Olivier narrates the definitive series on World War II. Hear why Germany, stricken by defeat in WWI, looked to Adolf Hitler for hope.
The story of the discovery and exploitation of the Baku Oilfields in the Russian Caucasus, which forced Stalin and Hitler to face-off in the battle of Stalingrad.
Fiona Bruce presents from Eltham Palace in South London, where finds include a collection of Gerry and Sylvia Anderson puppets.
Fiona Bruce and the team of antiques experts visit Erddig, north Wales, where items include a dazzling emerald and diamond ring worn by the owner's grandmother on the Titanic.

programmes.d: Simon Reeve traces the path of the northern tropic around the globe. He begins in Mexico before heading east to Cuba and finishing in the Bahamas.
Derek goes to pick up a veteran 1904 Swift, there's an emotional farewell to a 1980s Bedford HA van, and a Toyota Corona finds a new home.
The team acquire an 80s Austin Allegro and soon find out how it got the nickname 'all aggro'. Next, they take on a DIY project to save some cash with a 90s Vauxhall Corsa.

Michael Portillo travels from the chateaux of the Loire Valley to the heart of the Champagne region at Reims.

On a railway journey from the capital Palermo to Europe's largest volcano, Mount Etna, Michael Portillo explores Sicilian life under Mussolini.
Michael Portillo travels by train through Austria and the Czech Republic, beginning in the northern Austrian city of Linz, where Adolf Hitler lived as a boy.
Derek heads to Sunderland to pick up a real Italian beauty - a 1972 Lancia Fulvia Zagato. Red and racy, the car has seen better days but he's still impressed.
Does one fewer wheel mean cheaper bills? That's the question the team want to find out this week as they take on a three wheeled wonder - the Reliant Robin.
Improve your knowledge of WWII with this acclaimed series narrated by Laurence Olivier. As the Nazi war machine sweeps across Europe, an uneasy calm settles on Britain.
Find out how Fiat didn't just make cars: they made trains, they made planes, and like modern-day kingmakers, they made and broke governments too.
Fiona Bruce presents from Crathes Castle, Aberdeenshire, where finds include a collection of signed Harry Potter books and a baseball cap with an unusual story to tell.
Fiona Bruce presents from Cromer seafront in Norfolk, where finds on display include a goblet that survived the Great Fire of London and a sketch that may be by LS Lowry.
Mathewsons agree to sell a vintage threshing machine and collection of tractors, but extracting them from a Yorkshire farm proves a bigger job than anticipated.
A Cold War Soviet classic goes under the hammer. Built like a tank, the Moskvitch gets few admirers for style, but finds a home with a fan of Eastern Bloc classics.

programmes.d: Simon Reeve travels through Western Sahara, Mauritania, Algeria and Libya, meeting campaigners for indigenous people's rights, and visiting a minefield.
Author and broadcaster Simon Reeve travels around the equator, beginning by visiting African countries including Gabon and Kenya.
Guy Martin joins the crew of an RNLI lifeboat in his hometown of Grimsby as he tackles a selfless and demanding job where volunteers put their lives on the line every day.
After clearing out a home in Leeds, the team sort through a van full of mysterious boxes. Plus, Angus checks out a retired archaeologist's beautiful collection.
Derbyshire hosts a road tripping rematch as James Braxton is drawn to kitchenalia and Izzie Balmer picks up a smashing find.
A car show in Paris with his new business manager inspires Richard to restore his own E-type Jag. The Cogs take on a rare ceremonial Land Rover.
Sam and Catie help tame a heavily modified BMW. But can they solve a late problem and help John finally hit 140mph at the Castle Combe circuit.
MotoGP: Malaysia Highlights. Highlights of all the action from the MotoGP 2026 motorcycle racing World Championship at the Sepang International Circuit in Malaysia.
How do planes take off and land on a beach at one of the world's oldest airports? And, how do they hand-make the national dress of Bavaria, lederhosen.
How do they catch the world's largest lobsters? How do they build the iconic chesterfield sofa? And, how do they capture the world's sharpest TV pictures.
How do they take a car from Siberia to the Sahara without leaving Germany? Plus, how do they hand craft a baseball glove that will last a lifetime.
How do they print over 10 million copies a day of the world's best-selling newspaper? How do they knit 32,000 pairs of socks a day at South Africa's biggest sock factory.
With her new shop opening, Viki fills the van while on the road with Drew. They snap up French advertising art and a dolls-house cabinet.
Drew teaches Al about buying from sources off limits to the competition. They nab a collection of crucibles and patterns at a Lancashire foundry.
In Hampshire Drew and Paul uncover a rare 1960s MGC, but clash over how to restyle it. And, in Dorset, they fall for an 80s BMW 635 Coupe left in a barn for 15 years.
Find out how firemen's helmets, nautical compasses, packaging tubes and hand saws are made, as more items are put under the microscope.
Find out how halogen bulbs, cellulose insulation, aluminium ladders and bamboo fly rods are made, as more items are put under the microscope.

Upholsterer Craig and blacksmith Nev transform a bulky lounge chair into something more artistic. Leather worker Martin rescues an Asprey picnic set.
Drew Pritchard visits a historic hop farm in Kent and discovers some unexpected finds amongst the cobwebs. Plus, he gets a touch of Hollywood glamour.
Drew discovers a design at one of his favourite houses in Norfolk. Later, he visits a museum in a giant windmill and an antiques shop in Edinburgh.
Vern and Marko are at crisis point and Rick takes to the air in a race to peg a new lease. Plus, Alex hunts down poachers before a sunset wedding on his Quartz Hill lease.
The Dirt Dogs face the fallout after Marko's shock departure, but they fight back with big tech. Plus, Rick launches a solo rescue mission for a rookie prospector.
The end of the mining season is near. The Rookies gamble their hopes on one last haul of opal and the Opal Queen makes a final desperate dig.
The Bushmen clash with opal thieves raiding one of their mines. The Cookes hack an old digging machine, while the Fire Crew hunt for a deposit of rare black opal.
Buy What You Love. Drew scours a Surrey sculpture park, where a pair of rare 18th century church lych-gates catches his eye. And in London, he visits a small showroom with big character.
Henry and Fuzz find a rare custom IRIS Sporting Trials Car. It's irresistible for the boys who get to work returning it to its former glory.
Henry and Fuzz are staying local, visiting Francis' farm in Oxfordshire. There's tractors, bikes and trinkets, but what will they come away with.
Henry and Fuzz are down in Somerset visiting Mike's farm. Will they play it safe with a motorbike or take a risk on something agricultural.

programmes.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
programmes.d: Henry and Simon head to the Norfolk Broads to rake through a couple's hoard of junk. They find an American pick-up truck and an old bird cage.
In search of treasure, Angus visits the stunning home of former royal correspondent Jennie Bond and clears soap legend Sid Owen's idyllic French retreat.
In Knaresborough, Angus sorts through a massive collection of model aircrafts and incredible paintings. Later, Angus auctions off some iconic toys.
Experts James and Izzie are rematch ready in Cheshire and Staffordshire. They find items with a shellfish theme and a booze-related bulky buy.
Sam and Catie help tame a heavily modified BMW. But can they solve a late problem and help John finally hit 140mph at the Castle Combe circuit.
The Cogs paint an iconic Shelby Mustang for a Danish museum. Richard and best mate Les make idiots of themselves with an epic fail at Silverstone.
Mechanical expert Steve has a tricky problem trying to fix an old school calculator. And the team take on a well-loved garden bench and an antique bridle.
How do they produce 99% of America's raisins in California's San Joaquin Valley? Plus, how do they make the world's oldest type of paper.
How do they use ancient techniques and modern technology to produce thousands of tonnes of barbecue charcoal? How do they cook up Japan's soba noodles.
How do they grow America's only freshwater pearls in Tennessee? Plus, what secrets are behind how the world's sharpest knives are made.
How do they turn root vegetables into sweet sugar? How do they make feather dusters? And, how do they make billions of balloons to keep parties popping.
Drew takes Viki to three types of hunting grounds that have been staples of his business. They snap up a rare Anglepoise lamp along the way.
Drew snaps up a rare pair of console tables in Sherborne. Then, he visits the UK's last drop hammer tool-making forge before picking in the Cotswolds.
Morris Minor Traveller & Maserati Ghibli. The boys find a Morris Traveller at the largest private car collection in the UK. And, in Surrey they spot a rare but affordable Maserati.
Find out how drill bits, photo booths and stamps are made, as more everyday items are put under the microscope.
Find out how yacht wheels, braided rugs, car thermostats and chisels are made, as more everyday items are put under the microscope.

Teleshopping.
Drew asks Michael and Maria to revamp a ventriloquist doll that's over 100 years old. Lighting expert Jolene is tasked with reviving a dusty chandelier.
Drew discovers a classic manor house in Oxfordshire has a quirky interior. And he meets the next generation of antiques dealers near Newcastle.
Drew visits an antiques shop in Edinburgh and a cycle museum. Exploring a 750-year-old house, he finds an item that takes him out of his comfort zone.
Scorching 45-degree desert heat pushes Rick to his limit. Alex risks facing snakes in his hunt for gold-rich pay dirt, and Greg crosses Australia to care for his sick father.
The Dirt Dogs and Gold Gypsies fight back against the rising number of gold thieves. Meanwhile, the Scrappers' washplant conveyor belt comes to a screaming halt.
Bushmen Rod and Les risk their lives reopening a long-abandoned mine. New team the Young Guns go deep underground for the first time, hunting pineapple opal.
Rookie team the Young Guns have a life-threatening moment hunting legendary pineapple opal. The Cooke Bros scramble to hunt on another miner's claim for a share of the find.
Yorkshire Special. In Sheffield, Drew finds a stunning collection of antique cutler's stools. Later, he heads to Leeds where he finds some rare streetlights at a heritage railway and museum.
The duo explore Shane's epic collection, where a stylish Lanchester LD10 catches their eye - a perfect fit for their love of post-war British cars.
The pursuit of profit sees Henry and Fuzz rummaging through Rebecca and Sue's sheds near Newark. It's home to all manner of vehicles and parts.
In Bournemouth, Henry and Fuzz look through Max's vast automobilia collection. Whilst some are fully restored, others need fixing up. What will they come away with.

programmes.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
programmes.d: The boys head to Birmingham, where they look through a demolition expert's trove of salvage. Simon finds a dilapidated chaise longue and then the boys argue about an old bench.
Angus finds quirky mementoes in TV presenter Helen Skelton's beautiful home and explores comedy legend Nick Hancock's barn conversion.
The team clear out the home of a retired couple who own an impressive collection of Ladderax furniture. Later, Angus sees potential in some commemorative coins.
Auctioneer James Braxton and Izzie Balmer hit Shropshire in the Morris Minor for the third leg. From bamboo buys to beautiful boating, it's a hoot.
Action Stations! A battalion of Action Man toys, an old RAF jacket, and a Second World War sweetheart brooch end up in a bidding war as they go under Angus's gavel.
Irita cuts through a clearance of vintage gear in a Kent barbershop, but the discovery of a 300-year-old Chinese vase excites the sale room.
The Mooka Boys may lose a potential investor due to their little mining progress. Disaster strikes for the Opal Whisperers when Sofia's hoist fails.
The Dirt Dogs take on the biggest gamble of their career, and the Gold Gypsies tear into an all-or-nothing final mission. Meanwhile Rick digs deep to save his season.
The Dirt Dogs go to Kalgoorlie to process the gold from their Heap Leach. Meanwhile, Ted and Lecky's daughter, model and jewellery designer Tyler, joins their hunt for pay dirt.
The Tiny Terror. Owners Heather and Simon are terrified that Savage the chihuahua will eventually hurt one of their visitors. Can Victoria tame this tiny terror.
The Bullish Terrier. Staffordshire Bull Terrier Marley has totally trashed her owner's house, destroying furniture, walls and doors. Can Victoria tame this destructive dog.
Felines And Frenemies? Roommates Josh and Grace can't keep their cats from attacking each other. Plus, Jackson works with a mother-daughter duo struggling with a fearful feral cat.
Josh, Jess and Phil are looking for a werewolf-like creature in Wisconsin. Eyewitness accounts have led them on their quest to a remote forest.
On a boiling hot Brazilian island, aggressive anaconda and deadly stingray torment survivalists Whitney and Nathan, pushing them to breaking point.
All-stars Jake and Melissa are in a Florida swamp. They face snakes and alligators and when one gets lost, local authorities are called in to rescue to them.

The buyers bid against one another for lost airport items in Toronto. Mark and Billy bid for photography equipment and the Martins want a rare stamp collection.
The buyers are in North Carolina to bid on lost, damaged and misplaced freight. They all compete for a box of war antiques, plus they bid on a cage of unknown items.
Chris finds himself stranded on the ice and Shawn hits a mysterious dry spell. The Kellys' brand-new Crawler awakens but encounters electrical problems.
The Kellys unveil their secret gold mining weapon. A scary close call forces Zeke to adjust his strategy. Tensions boil over between Jess and her crew.
The Poseidon Crew's mine site is swamped after a brutal storm. Ryan collapses in a deadly heatwave, while Russell and Shane uncover a big nugget.
A woman wants a beach getaway on the white sandy beaches of Ambergris Caye, Belize, so hires an experienced construction crew to build on the remote island.
A couple want to build an underground home in Denver. They want it to be solar powered, open-plan and they want to make sure there is plenty of light.
A 30-foot wave crushes a Titan Explorer deckhand, threatening Jake's captaincy. On the Time Bandit, Johnathan loses a generator and goes dark.
Experts investigate the disappearance of people who have gone missing while swimming in the Triangle. Some locals believe a sea monster is responsible.
Josh journeys from Russia to Germany in search of history's most expensive stolen object, the Amber Chamber. He retraces the steps of Nazi soldiers.
Josh Gates hunts down new evidence on the disappearance of Amelia Earhart. He starts in Papua New Guinea, ending his journey in Fiji, hoping to find her remains.
Virginia homesteaders are on the brink after the unexplained disappearance of their water and food sources. The Raneys race to solve these mysteries.
The Blacklighters discover opalised sea creatures in an ancient seabed. The Cheals close in on their biggest opal haul ever, but all is not as it seems.
The Mooka Boys attempt to reach a new mine on a treacherous opal field. Plus, the Blacklighters are almost buried alive mining opal in unstable tunnels.
The Dirt Dogs are determined to get the gold-tally up after last year's devastating season. Meanwhile, the Scrappers are stuck building their machine leaving them behind schedule.
The Dirt Dogs are under more pressure when their plant doesn't deliver the gold they're expecting. Meanwhile, the Scrappers are in trouble before they've even started mining.
Jim Foody transports critical medical supplies through flood-ravaged roads. Jake Pakai hauls multimillion-dollar equipment across narrow highways.
Mel and Alex explore dangerous old mine shafts looking for a new source of gold. Plus, the Heli-hunters race to stake a claim and finish their season.
Video captured by the U.S. Navy triggers Jess and Phil's investigation into mysterious, supersonic craft flying above the waters off California's Catalina Island.
A Bear, shark and rattlesnake attack survivor teams up with Brooke, an elite hunter. Together they tackle vicious lions and hyena in the harsh African feeding ground.
When a third survivalist crashes the challenge, tension and jealousy prove just as threatening as the heat, piranha and jaguars of the Ecuadorian rainforest.

The Baggage Battlers head to Atlanta, Georgia, to a freight auction where Mark spies some Rolls Royce aircraft parts, but will his bid secure the items.
Chris McCully and crew hit a paystreak so lucrative they call it 'Wall Street.' Shawn strikes gold at 40 feet under the ice. Vernon's diver faces a disaster.
Jane clashes with Emily's crew over being disrespected. Equipment failures cause delays for Chris and Shawn. Kris is thrilled to find his Crawler in action.
The Gold Devils set their sights on a record-breaking total. Plus, a gold drought causes one member of the Poseidon Crew to question his future.
After years of apprenticing for natural builders, Sonia Havill is putting her skills to the test by building an off-grid cob cottage on top of an Oregon mountain.
Two natural builders team up to experiment with a never-before used building material: mushrooms. They hope to virtually grow a home that blends into the environment.
Keith must retrieve a lost anchor in 50-knot winds. Sig attempts a risky new fishing strategy. Rick faces losing a greenhorn to a gruesome injury.
New discoveries might finally explain the truth behind one of the Triangle's most infamous mysteries, when 306 US Navy crewmen vanished without a trace.
Josh treks the Inca Trail through the Andes and into the Peruvian Amazon in search of a mythical city of gold. His journey takes a detour to the ruins of Machu Picchu.
Josh dives into the Lajas Reef in search of the treasure of legendary pirate Henry Morgan. His journey takes him to a modern marvel, the Panama Canal.
A Big Island family finds their off-grid paradise strangled by destructive storms that bring deadly pests and invasive guava trees.
The Opal Whisperers' partnership with veteran miner Uwe ends abruptly. The Misfits finally hit old timers' workings at the bottom of their open cut mine.
The broke Bushmen are forced to trade opal to get a shaft drilled on a new claim. The Digi Diggers get lost exploring a terrifying abandoned mine.
Rick's start to the season only gets worse when he finds his truck's been ransacked. Plus, the Dirt Dogs ambush a gold thief and their chances of a profit takes a hit.
The Gold Gypsies get to work to reach their ambitious target. Plus, desperate to get back on track, Rick takes a gamble and heads to an old mining town. But will it pay off.
A widowed homesteader, realising she didn't learn the skills she needed before her husband's passing, is overwhelmed by her large family homestead.
